protocol.calibration_policy: last 20 eligible train points; labels exit before validation; never choose by outcome
protocol.repeat_policy: decision repeat 0 is end-to-end repeat 0; decision repeats 1-9 reuse exactly its archived reports; end-to-end repeats 1-4 regenerate upstream
protocol.backtest_node_policy: Indicator and Alpha are deterministic Python; Pattern and Trend use vision LLM; Decision uses text LLM
protocol.sentiment_policy: new pinned local scores on deduplicated cache; date-only next day; publication/content PIT unverified; no peers
protocol.peer_policy: empty frozen peer set; no inferred or live company relationships
protocol.matched_information_policy: raw 45-session OHLCV plus exact selected-alpha numeric values/metrics and frozen sentiment/missingness used by Full; no LLM report embeddings
protocol.exposure_policy: Bernoulli probability from archived Full decisions on 20 train calibration points of each symbol/fold; fixed seeds; never Full test LONG rate
protocol.factor_policy: 85 causal numeric candidates; train-only orientation; fixed equal vote
protocol.failure_policy: archive and stop shard; no fallback model or synthetic prediction; resume node cache under identical hashes
protocol.ledger_scope: fractional, daily close MTM, immediate cash, no tax/dividend/settlement/fill feasibility certification; continuous hold is price-only
protocol.inference_scope: descriptive effect distributions; folds/dates/repeats are dependent, not independent market observations; no superiority p-value
protocol.acceptance_scope: common-snapshot baseline evidence for R1; does not close R2/R3/R6/R9/R15 release gates or establish prospective validity
